question: Should Neuralwatt ship with prepaid-credit-only reporting, or must active subscription kWh allowance also be shown before merge?
rationale: Both quota pools are present in the API response, and balance-only reporting can display an exhausted state for an account that still has usable subscription capacity; only maintainers can define the intended product contract.

options.title: Show Both Quota Pools
options.body: Render prepaid USD credits and active subscription kWh allowance as distinct metrics so the menu reflects all usable capacity.

options.title: Accept Balance-Only Semantics
options.body: Explicitly approve prepaid credits as the provider's sole displayed contract and clearly label subscription allowance as unsupported.

options.title: Defer Neuralwatt
options.body: Pause the integration until the mixed-unit quota presentation and exact-head runtime proof are available.

recommendation.title: Show Both Quota Pools
recommendation.body: Render prepaid USD credits and active subscription kWh allowance as distinct metrics so the menu reflects all usable capacity.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the provider hardening commits and are the strongest available owner for deciding its displayed quota contract.
